primary.instructions: Read the entire letter. Select the candidate best representing the patient's current epileptic seizure burden. Exclude superseded history, future thresholds, treatment and other people. Do not replace positive burden with absence between episodes. Use unsupported when evidence is missing from candidates; use ambiguous when a single candidate cannot faithfully represent the burden.

criteria.s0: Previously the patient had 9 seizures per week.
criteria.s2: Between cluster days the patient is seizure-free.
criteria.s3: Contact the clinic if cluster days exceed 3 per month.
criteria.no_current: The letter does not establish a current seizure burden.
criteria.unsupported: Current burden exists but the candidates cannot represent it.
criteria.ambiguous: Several incompatible or complementary candidates prevent a single selection.

s0.role.instructions: For candidate s0 (Previously the patient had 9 seizures per week.) in the context of the entire letter: Classify its clinical role.

criteria.current: Describes the patient's present or ongoing epileptic seizure burden.
criteria.historical: Describes an earlier epileptic seizure burden, superseded or historical.
criteria.future: A prospective or conditional statement, not observed current burden.
criteria.other: Treatment, another person, non-epileptic events or unrelated information.
criteria.unknown: The clinical role or current epileptic seizure burden is not established.

s0.structure.instructions: For candidate s0 (Previously the patient had 9 seizures per week.) in the context of the entire letter: Classify the measurement structure.

criteria.rate: Individual seizure events recur per stated time denominator.
criteria.count: Finite observed events in an observation window; recurrence is not asserted.
criteria.cluster: Grouped seizure episodes distinguish group recurrence from individual events.
criteria.seizure_free: Absence of the relevant seizures over a stated interval or anchor.
criteria.qualitative: Seizure frequency expressed without a numerical measurement.
criteria.unsupported: No supported measurement in these categories.

s0.outer_value.instructions: For candidate s0 (Previously the patient had 9 seizures per week.) in the context of the entire letter: Select the exact source quantity for individual event recurrence, group recurrence or observed event count. Do not select a duration, dose or within-group count. Use not_applicable for seizure freedom or non-seizure statements.

criteria.not_established: Relevant quantity is not stated or cannot be represented.
criteria.not_applicable: This quantity does not apply to this candidate.
